items.title: state_index_export: scan docs/roadmaps/ as tool_roadmap kind
items.objective: Extend state_index_export.v0 to scan docs/roadmaps/ (recursive: hub files + tools/*.md); tools/*.md classify as the ONE new kind 'tool_roadmap'; non-tool hub files fall through the existing kind_ambiguous discipline; deterministic output preserved; existing kinds unchanged. Objective source: .governor/backlog/state-index-roadmap-kind.json (acceptance verbatim); gap spec specs/gaps/GOV_GAP_ROADMAP_INDEX_LEGIBILITY_001.md.
stop_conditions: a roadmap taxonomy redesign becomes necessary (kinds beyond tool_roadmap)
deterministic ordering or any existing kind's classification would change
the change needs CLI surface changes beyond the existing state-index group
